name: fonts
title: Gamestage fonts
description: DM Sans for interface text and Unbounded for numbers a player tracks (score, timer, rank, multiplier, level), self-hosted. No request leaves for a third-party origin: the Google Fonts @import this used to carry sent every player's IP address to Google on page load, before any consent gate could run, and that stopped a prize draw in four territories (GSUI-149). Kept in a separate stylesheet so a customer with their own typeface can replace the font loading without forking the components. Renders nothing, creates no DOM and sets no root attribute: it loads font faces and does not apply the token styles. `tokens` lists this item as a registry dependency, so installing tokens installs it too, and the fonts stylesheet is imported before the tokens stylesheet. For a customer typeface, supply that font stylesheet and override the font tokens rather than importing this one.

docs: Declares DM Sans (interface text, weights 400-900) and Unbounded (numbers a player tracks, weights 500-900) from files served by your own origin. Import gamestage-fonts.css once at the root, before gamestage-tokens.css; the woff2 files land in app/gamestage-fonts/ beside it and the stylesheet finds them by relative path, so serve that directory as a static asset. Both faces are latin only, which covers western Europe and not Polish, Czech, Turkish or Vietnamese. About 88KB for the two. The `font` block is metadata the installer reads for nothing; the @font-face rules in the stylesheet are the only loading mechanism this item ships, and `font.import` is blank because there is nothing remote to import. The licences, the versions and where each file came from are in packages/tokens/gamestage-fonts/README.md, and each OFL.txt ships beside the faces because the licence has to travel with them.
